ground_truth.rationale: _estimate_survey_sample discards the solver's residuals, recomputes response - design @ coef, and passes the UNREDUCED full design into the survey sandwich. Rank-deficient nuisance columns then NaN-poison the SE/t/p/CI of an otherwise identified treatment effect on the survey path.
